USE CASES

What you can do

Explore a particular scene

Describe not only the people and places in your dream, but what happened and how you felt.

Reflect on recurring dreams

Explain recurring elements and recent changes in your life, then ask how they might relate.

Explore an interpretation further

Ask about parts you do not understand or add scenes you remember later to continue the conversation.

PRODUCT DETAILS

Features

01

Describe your dream

Write the dream in the order you remember it. You can also explain whether it was your dream or someone else’s.

02

Choose a question to explore

Add a focus, such as the overall meaning, relationships, recent events or recurring patterns. You can also submit just the dream without choosing a focus.

03

Include how you felt

Describe feelings such as fear, happiness or unease. The interpretation considers scenes and feelings together, rather than isolated symbols.

04

Initial and detailed interpretations

Read an answer to your main question first, then explore individual scenes in more detail if needed. Prices shown in the development preview are not an announcement of a commercial offering.

05

Ask follow-up questions

Add newly remembered scenes or real-life context and ask another question. The conversation can revisit the interpretation with the added information.

06

Reopen or delete results

We are developing ways to reopen or delete results. Retention and terms of use will be finalized before a full release.

WORKFLOW

How to use it

The basic steps to get started.

  1. 01

    Write the dream and context

    Describe the scenes, people and feelings you remember.

  2. 02

    Add your question

    Mention what you want to explore first, such as a recurring dream or a particular scene.

  3. 03

    Read the interpretation

    Read the main answer and scene-by-scene explanation. A dream is not treated as a definite prediction of future events.

  4. 04

    Continue with more details

    Ask about unclear parts or add scenes you remember later. Features may vary between preview versions.

BEFORE YOU START

Requirements & limitations

Product type
Conversational dream interpretation on the web
Input
Dream narrative, questions and feelings. The current preview input supports up to 2,000 characters.
Availability
The development preview can be explored without an entry password. Public access and terms of use may change.
Scope of interpretation
Content for personal reflection. It does not predict the future or provide medical diagnoses.

CURRENT STATUS

In development

A product in development. The linked deployment is for development and review, so its screens and features may differ from this description.

Frequently asked questions

Can I see the preview now?+

Yes. The development preview is accessible without an entry password. Repeated requests and duplicate generation are limited.

Is the preview a released service?+

Yeoun is in development at Nodeoff. Public features and terms of use may change during development.

Can a dream tell me what will happen?+

A dream cannot establish real events or another person’s thoughts. Use the interpretation as material for exploring your dream and feelings from different perspectives.
